times_note: Technical options, Production times, Special production: 'Standard starting at 8WD', 'Express service starting at 1WD' (working days); the quote sets the actual turn. https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/products/printed-circuit-boards.html
min_trace_source-s: CONFLICT ON MULTI-CB'S OWN PAGES. Design parameters, H/I Conductors, Special production (min.): width 75 um / space 75 um ('exemplary for 35um copper thickness'); pooling page, Non-Pool Special production: 'Min. track / space, annular ring >= 75um'. Technical options, Special production: 'Conductor width / spacing min. 75um/105um 90um/90um'. BGA design page, 0.50 mm pitch: 'Track-width / -space 70um/90um', inner-layer fan-out with 1 track 80/80 um. Top level takes the design-parameters 75/75; at 75/105 or 90/90 one track needs 0.285 / 0.27 mm. Confirm on the quote. https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/design-parameters.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/products/printed-circuit-boards.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/bga-pcb-design-for-ball-grid-array.html
via_source-s: Design parameters, A-C Via / buried via, Special production: aspect 1:12, diameter 150 um, via pad 300 um, annular ring 75 um circular. Drills page: drilling smallest 0.1 mm (1:10, rfq 1:20), laser 0.075 mm (1:1). Technical options, Special: 'Vias min. O 75um', 'Vias Pad min. O 225um', 'Via annular rings min. 75um'; Blind via laser (design parameters): 100 um / pad 280 um / ring 90 um ('Prior data check necessary'). https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/design-parameters.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/drills-throughplating.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/products/printed-circuit-boards.html
via_in_pad_standard_source-s: Via-in-pad page, 'Via-in-Pad Parameters': Special production IPC 4761 Type VII (filled & capped) min drill 150 um, min pad 350 um, min pitch 550 um, 1:12; a second Special production column with filling 'none': drill 100 um, pad 300 um, min pitch 500 um, 1:10 ('A via diameter of 100um is technically possible, and results in a pitch of 500um. Please contact our cam department in advance.'). BGA page, 0.50 mm pitch via-in-pad 300 um pad / 100 um drill, 'please order as IPC 4761 Type VII: Filled & Capped Vias' -- conflicts with the via-in-pad page's 'none'. Technical options: 'Filled & capped vias' '-' in the calculator, '+' in special production. https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/drills-throughplating/via-in-pad.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/pcb-design-aid/bga-pcb-design-for-ball-grid-array.html ; https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/products/printed-circuit-boards.html

edge_source-s: Design parameters J, conductor/pad to milling edge 200 um, to scoring edge 500 um (both columns)
layers_note-s: Technical options: rigid 1-48 layers in special production; layer_counts lists the even counts to 20 only as the ones a board here would use, Multi-CB lists no count set

impedance_source-s: Technical options, Quality controls: 'Impedance control | - | + | Precision up to 5% for 50 Ohms' (calculator '-', special '+')

stackups_note: Only the free 8-layer defined buildup 8L-01 (1.7 mm) is published (from multi_cb.json, read 2026-10-17); Multi-CB publishes no 10-layer buildup -- special production uses a 'custom' buildup set on the quote (pooling page, 8 layers: 'Layer buildup | defined: 8L-01 (1.7mm), variable | | custom'). Four 'Defined layer buildups' (free of charge, also in pool). Every layer thickness and every Ԑr is printed in the PDF and the same figures appear in the four PNG images on the impedance-examples page; images were viewed to place each Ԑr on its layer (PDF text extraction scrambles the column order). Header note: 'Only nominal values'; 'Specified prepreg thicknesses: after pressing, at approx. 80% copper utilisation on the inner layers.' Outer copper is printed 'Cu 18µm + plating' with 35µm in the thickness column, so thickness_mm 0.035 is the plated value and weight_oz/copper_outer_oz 0.5 is the 18 µm base foil. No 2-layer stackup with Ԑr is published, and no 1.6 mm 8-layer (8L-01 is 1.7 mm). Order: 4L-01 (1.6), 6L-01 (1.6), 8L-01 (1.7), then 4L-02 (1.0). The default 'variable layer buildup' (FR4 1,55 mm, prepregs/cores vary with availability) has no published stackup. Separate Rogers 4350B/FR4 hybrid buildup PDF exists but was not transcribed (RF material).
